questions.question: A functional group is best defined as:
options: The longest carbon chain in a molecule
A bond, atom or group of atoms that determines the properties of a family of organic compounds
Any atom that is not carbon or hydrogen
The suffix at the end of an IUPAC name

questions.question: In a homologous series, each member differs from the previous one by:
options: A CH₂ unit — one carbon and two hydrogens

questions.question: An unsaturated compound is one that contains:
options: At least one double or triple carbon-to-carbon bond

questions.question: The condensed formula CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₃ represents:

subtopics.title: Nine Families and Their Functional Groups

questions.question: The general formula of the alkenes is:
In a ketone, the carbonyl carbon:
options: Sits at the end of the chain bonded to a hydrogen
Carries a hydroxyl group as well
Sits inside the chain, bonded to a carbon on each side

questions.question: The carboxyl group, COOH, consists of:
options: A double-bonded oxygen and a hydroxyl group on the same end carbon
Two hydroxyl groups on one carbon
An oxygen bridging two carbon chains
A triple bond between carbon and oxygen

questions.question: Which suffix belongs to the aldehydes?
A five-carbon chain with a methyl group on the second carbon is named:
A four-carbon chain with a hydroxyl group on the second carbon is:
A five-carbon chain with a double bond between carbons 2 and 3 and a methyl group on carbon 4 is named:
To draw 2-chloropentane you would place:
options: A chlorine on carbon 2 of a five-carbon chain, then fill with hydrogens
Two chlorines on a pentane chain
A chlorine on carbon 5 of a two-carbon chain
A chlorine on each end of a five-carbon chain

questions.question: Structural isomers always share the same:
Pentane, 2-methylbutane and 2,2-dimethylpropane, all C₅H₁₂, are examples of:
options: The same molecule drawn three ways

questions.question: Pentan-1-ol and pentan-2-ol are positional isomers because they differ only in:
options: The position of the hydroxyl group on the same chain
The length of the carbon chain

questions.question: Butanal and butanone, both C₄H₈O, are classified as:
options: Functional isomers — same formula, different homologous series

subtopics.title: A Surname, a First Name and a House Number

questions.question: In the name pentan-2-ol, the part "pent" tells you:
options: The OH group is on carbon 5
The main chain is five carbons long

questions.question: The suffix of an organic name — the "family surname" — tells you:
options: Which functional group and family the molecule belongs to

questions.question: If numbering from one end puts the functional group at 2 and from the other end at 4, the name must use:
options: 2, because the functional group takes the lowest number available

questions.question: In 1,2-dibromopropane, the prefix "di" indicates:
options: Two bromine atoms on the chain

questions.question: In every correct organic structure, each carbon atom holds exactly:
options: As many bonds as it likes

questions.question: The three building passes, in the correct order, are:
options: Carbon spine, then functional group and branches at their numbers, then hydrogens
Functional group, then hydrogens, then spine

questions.question: In 2-methylpentane, carbon 2 of the main chain carries how many hydrogens?
The molecular formula of 2-methylpentane, found by the four-hands audit, is:
Five carbons drawn in a straight line, and five carbons drawn with an elbow bend in the picture, are:
options: The same molecule — the drawing bent, not the bonds

questions.question: To create a genuine chain isomer of pentane you must:
options: Move a carbon off the end of the chain and bond it as a branch
Replace a hydrogen with a hydroxyl group

questions.question: Rearranging the atoms of C₄H₈O from butanal into butanone produces a:
options: Functional isomer — the molecule changed family

questions.question: Every valid isomer of a compound must keep the same:
